nom: Drunk Elephant B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum

segments.oily: Oily and combination-oily reviewers report the serum leaves no shine or heaviness while still adding hydration, working well as a lightweight base under makeup.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, dehydrated, dull, or flaky skin most consistently report reduced tightness, softer texture, and relief from seasonal dryness, though a couple found it insufficient on its own.
segments.combination: Combination (including combo-oily) reviewers describe it as balanced and non-greasy, fitting well under makeup and moisturizer without pilling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report good tolerance, no fragrance issues, and even barrier-calming effects, but this is also the segment where the two irritation/burning complaints originate.
segments.mature: One reviewer with fine lines and wrinkles reports visible improvement in texture and a brightening effect alongside hydration.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report quick absorption and a plumper, less tight, more hydrated feel, often describing it as an easy daily hydration step; a few say results were subtle or not dramatic (e.g. i15, i37) and one found no improvement in dryness after two weeks (i2).
concerns.aging: One reviewer reports improved fine lines and texture alongside hydration; another mentions a general improvement in texture and wrinkles.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports reduced redness alongside smoother skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the serum as helping repair her skin barrier quickly after over-washing; several others associate it with a 'balanced' or less-irritated feel, though two reviewers report burning/irritation instead (i0, i1).
concerns.spots: One long-time user with acne-prone combination-dry skin reports her trouble areas cleared with regular use, with no mention of clogging.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer, generally wary of the brand due to past breakouts from other products, reports this specific serum caused no new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combo-oily reviewers report no added shine or heaviness, describing the finish as balanced rather than greasy.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and sunscreen
Pump packaging seen as hygienic and convenient
Small product amount for the price

extraits.texte: gifted by drunkelephant. This was moisturizing but it really irritated my skin. I tried it a few times and I'm not sure which ingredient in this is causing the reaction but I cannot use this any longer.

gifted by drunkelephant The B-Hydra™ Intensive Hydration Serum also known as the pineapple ceramide with pro vitamin B5 with a pH of 5.7 felt really refreshing on my dry skin. The change of weather has really left my skin feeling more dry and a little more irritated this serum added the extra hydration that my skin needed helping me to look more radiant and my skin to look healthy. The price point is a little bit on the higher end and the jar is not that big, but the product really helps moisturize my skin.

I'm not new to this serum.I've used it for years and always loved it. I have combination skin that leans towards dry and its acne prone. So I really don't like using heavy serums because of that.So this is a great lightweight, fast absorbing serum. It gives you an instant hydration to the skin. I put it on in the morning underneath my makeup. And when I wash my face at the end of the day, it's soft and my trouble areas and dry patches.I've got away. It's filled as well, so I like to wear the peptide moisturizer over it. Overall, it's an excellent lightweight serum to instantly hydrate the skin. Gifted by drunk elephant

my sensitive skin absorbs this easily— seems to pretty immediately repair my skin's barrier if i've goofed up and washed my face too many times. i docked one star because it seems like there is considerably less product in the container than would appear so. it's a good product, but i think for the price it should come with a little more. been using this for a few weeks and my skin feels noticeably more hydrated and balanced. it's lightweight and absorbs quickly, and it helped smooth out dry, uneven texture. my skin looks softer overall, and makeup sits much better on top without clinging. #gifted by drunkelephant

I've been looking for a lightweight, hydrating moisturizer to wear under my makeup during the day, and so far I'm really loving the B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum. It feels so good on my skin and works perfectly as a one-and-done moisturizer for my oily skin. There's zero shine, but my skin still looks soft, plump, and hydrated, which is exactly what I want. I love it! Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

extraits.titre: A must have in my morning skincare routine!
extraits.texte: Not only is this serum hydrating and refreshing on the skin, but it's also very cooling. My complexion also looks much smoother after using. It reduces fine lines, redness, and it's been a game changer for my sensitive skin. Really loving it so far. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.
